title: tenaxia disticha
intro: Tenaxia disticha, commonly known as "Tulsi" or "Holy Basil," is a sacred plant in Ayurvedic medicine and an herbaceous perennial plant native to the tropical regions of India and Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Tenaxia disticha include its ability to reduce stress, improve cognitive function, and boost the immune system, while also possessing antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its adaptogenic properties, which help the body adapt to stress, and its antioxidant properties, which protect cells from damage caused by free radicals. The bioactive constituents of Tenaxia disticha include eugenol, ursolic acid, and rosmarinic acid, among others, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
